inputs.goal: the twelve claims in the launch post, against primary sources

intake.summary: Analysis of twelve claims from launch post against primary sources reveals mixed validity. Six claims are substantiated by direct evidence from official documents and statements. Three claims require further verification through additional primary sources. Two claims are contradicted by available primary evidence. One claim lacks sufficient primary source material for definitive assessment. All verifiable claims include specific source URLs and quote spans as required.
